read_global_point_cloud_csv: create a python module that reads a CSV point cloud file and returns a GlobalPointCloud list
read_global_point_cloud_gzip: create a python module that reads a gzipped CSV point cloud file and returns a GlobalPointCloud list
create_global_point_position: create a GlobalPointPosition object with uid, graph_uid, world coordinates, and distance standard deviation values
get_position_world: access the position_world property of a GlobalPointPosition to get its x, y, z world coordinates
open_compressed_stream: open a CSV or gzipped CSV file using CompressedIStream with the appropriate compression mode
